claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Clebopride is a dopamine D2 receptor antagonist with weak acetylcholinesterase inhibition; at 2.5 uM it is not expected to kill cancer cells through a cytotoxic mechanism, and any antiproliferative effect would be weak and non-selective.
